note: Ir: nucleated events (intact-nucleus events; viability is not assessed at this step) — right region (DNA1+), spanning a broad Event_length range. DNA1 is bimodal — the boundary is set at the valley between the DNA1- background peak and the DNA1+ nucleated peak; the low-DNA1 background on the left is excluded.
tips: Ir: DNA1+ (Iridium-191 intercalator labels nucleated events; FCS channel PnN=Ir191Di, PnS=DNA1). This is the first cleanup gate — the Bjornson workflow skips the usual Helios Gaussian-discrimination cascade (Center/Offset/Residual/Width) and goes directly from raw FCS to DNA × Event_length. The gate selects nucleated events on DNA1+ without explicit Event_length filtering — Event_length is shown on the y-axis primarily as a visualization context, and doublet/debris exclusion is effectively handled by the DNA1+ polygon shape and downstream marker-based gates. Note: Ir-intercalator labels both live and dead nucleated cells (dead cells often bind more intercalator due to increased membrane permeability), so this gate selects nucleated events but is NOT a viability gate.
